sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Anti-Flag antibody-mediated stimulation of surface-displayed MCEMP1 was demonstrated (L1); surface expression confirmed by FACS on native mast cell lines and transfected cells (L3). Tagged protein is functional as a stimulable surface receptor.
sites.rationale: MCEMP1 is a type II transmembrane protein with its N-terminus intracellular (1–81) and its C-terminus extracellular (107–187), giving exactly one extracellular terminus. L1 and L2 report a Flag epitope at the 'carboxyl-terminal extracellular domain' of full-length membrane-anchored MCEMP1; no residue number is stated, so the position is topology-derived as insert_after_residue=187 (the last residue, Q, confirmed by reading the numbered sequence). Python verification confirms residue 187 = Q and that the C-terminus is 81 residues from the TM boundary (106), well beyond the ≥3-residue minimum. Anti-Flag stimulation (L1) and FACS surface detection (L3) together satisfy surface_and_function. Full-length, membrane-anchored human MCEMP1 expressed in mammalian cells with a Flag epitope tag at the carboxyl-terminal extracellular domain (L1, L2). MCEMP1 is a type II single-pass TM protein (intracellular 1–81, TM 82–106, extracellular 107–187); its C-terminus is the sole extracellular terminus. No ledger line names a specific residue number, so the junction is topology-derived: insert_after_residue=187 (the final Q). L3 independently confirms the C-terminus is extracellular by FACS on native mast cell lines.

sources.claim: In addition, we incorporated a Flag epitope at the carboxyl-terminal extracellular domain of MCEMP1 to employ anti-Flag antibody-mediated stimulation of MCEMP1.

literature_notes: All three ledger lines converge on the same site: the C-terminal Flag tag on full-length membrane-anchored MCEMP1. L1 is the primary clip (names tag type, location, and functional use); L2 corroborates that every MCEMP1 expression plasmid carries this C-terminal Flag; L3 provides the original topology determination and FACS surface-expression confirmation. No ledger line names an internal loop insertion or an N-terminal tag, and the N-terminus (residues 1–81) is intracellular so it cannot carry a surface tag. No residue number is stated in any clip, so position_evidence is topology_derived rather than validated. The sole extracellular terminus is the C-terminus (residue 187, Q), making the junction unambiguous.
